title: watch's hold alert dereferences a nil clearing command
description: internal/cli/watch.go: the hold alert dereferences *clearing without a nil check; HoldClearingCommand returns nil when the epic id is empty, so watch can panic. Found folding main into epic/hn6 (2026-10-06); came from hn6's code.
acceptance_criteria: No panic with an empty epic id; a test covers it.
